Long, flowing platinum-white hair with straight-cut bangs and a silky texture. Sharp, piercing sapphire-blue eyes with a cold expression. Apparent age of twenty with a poised, aristocratic maturity. Slender, graceful build. Wears a high-collared white silk gown with gold filigree embroidery and a deep violet sash. A delicate gold circlet resting on the brow.
BODY COLOR: pale skin
